## Recall · Lecture 10

a) Which service keeps the progress of a player on a server?
b) What keeps copies of downloads near the players?
c) Which model gives ready accounts and leaderboards through an SDK?

::: {.answer}
a) a cloud save
b) a CDN
c) BaaS
:::

## Activity 1 · Four needs · 15 min

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- Dune Duel needs accounts, progress on every phone, a 120 MB track pack and live duels.
- **Do it:** Write the cloud service and the reason for each need. Does a game on your phone have a cloud save?
- Your product is a table of four rows and one answer.
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/game-cloud.png)
:::
::::

## Check 1 · Four needs

Which service fits each need of Dune Duel?

::: {.reveal}
1. Accounts come from a game back end (BaaS) through an SDK.
2. The progress on every phone is a cloud save that loads after the login.
3. The 120 MB track pack goes to object storage with a CDN, outside the app.
4. The live duels run on dedicated game servers, which decide who wins.
:::

## Check 2 · Six problems

What solves each problem of Pocket Quest?

::: {.reveal}
1. A cloud save brings back the progress of the lost phone.
2. A CDN copy near Amman makes the downloads fast, and a near region stops the jumping cars.
3. A dedicated server decides the race, so impossible times are stopped.
4. The secret key stays on the server, and a CDN with smaller packs lowers the doubled bill.
:::

## Wrap-up

- You can choose a cloud service for each need of a game.
- You can solve the cloud problems of an online game and keep its secrets safe.
